# Flametal ore

Type: Ore | Internal ID: FlametalOreNew | Source: Flametal ore vein, in the, Ashlands, biome | Usage: Smelting via, Blast furnace | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

# Introduction

Flametal ore is a metal ore obtained in Ashlands. It can be smelted into Flametal in a Blast furnace using Coal as fuel.
Flametal ore can be obtained by:
• Mining Flametal ore veins in the Ashlands, it requires at least a Black metal pickaxe.
• Found at Charred Fortresses inside the Charred Chests.
• By destroying Dvergr crate situated in Dvergr Charred tower ruins.
• When fishing a Magmafish.

## Notes

• Flametal was obtainable before the Ashlands update from Glowing metal piles and smelted into Flametal in a Blast furnace.
• Flametal ore obtained before the Ashlands update converts to "Ancient ore" and remains unusable. It possesses the ID of FlametalOre, whereas newly obtained ores have an ID of FlametalOreNew.
• Like other metals, Flametal ore cannot be teleported through a regular portal. It can be teleported through the Portal - Stone introduced in the Ashlands update.

Categorias: Ores, Can't be Teleported
